subject: Acme — Pricing & invoice estimate follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-18T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Acme — Post-call recap & initial cost model

Hi Tom / Jules,

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion on expected volumes and the integration path. Quick recap and next steps on pricing so we stay aligned:  

Summary of today's points:
- Expected monthly tokens (inference): 1.5M — 2.5M tokens (median ~2M).
- Burst spikes up to ~6M tokens/day for peak campaigns.
- Target unit economics: goal is to keep net cost around $800 - $1,200 per 1M tokens (after batching & caching) given inference latency requirements.
- Security requirements: SOC2 + VPC peering for production.

Next steps we discussed:
1) I'll share an initial cost model / invoice estimate (attached) that shows a few scenarios (base, growth, and burst).
2) You to confirm the monthly token baseline and any required retention/ingress egress constraints.
3) If numbers look good, we can prepare a formal invoice/PO-ready estimate and contract term sheet.

Attached: Acme_Cost_Model_draft_20271218.xlsx — rough cost model with assumptions and a simple pricing calculator.

A couple of clarifying Qs to help tighten the model:
- Can you confirm the 2M/month baseline (or give a preferred ballpark)?
- Is there a committed monthly budget range you are targeting (e.g., $5k-$15k /mo)?

I can iterate quickly once you confirm.

Thanks,
Sean
------------------------------
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jules Martin <jules.martin@acme.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme — Post-call recap & initial cost model

Sean,

Thanks for the recap and the draft. Quick answers below — great to see the scenarios.

> On 18 Dec 2027, at 15:10, Sean Gallagher wrote:
> > Can you confirm the 2M/month baseline (or give a preferred ballpark)?

We expect baseline closer to 2.2M tokens/month once initial integration is live. That should be steady for Q1; marketing pushes could double that in quarter bursts.

> > Is there a committed monthly budget range you are targeting (e.g., $5k-$15k /mo)?

Budget: our procurement team is looking for a predictable committed spend in the $8k-$12k/month range initially. We can consider a reserved plan if it reduces unit cost meaningfully.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you show the invoiced estimate for 2.2M/month and a 1M and 5M scenario in the next version?
- What is the target $/1M tokens after discounts and with standard batching applied? We want to include that in our TCO.

Thanks — look forward to the updated file.
Tom
Tom Lee
Senior PM, AI Integrations | Acme Corp
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>, Jules Martin <jules.martin@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-20T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Acme — Updated invoice estimate & cost model (3 scenarios)

Hi Tom / Jules,

Thanks — I updated the model and attached two files: Acme_Cost_Model_20271220.xlsx and pricing_calculator_20271220.csv. Changes included:
- Line-item invoice estimates for 1M / 2.2M / 5M monthly tokens.
- Unit economics rows that show gross token cost, batching/caching savings, estimated infra fee, and proposed per-M token effective price.
- A reserved capacity option (monthly commit) that reduces effective $/1M by ~18% at the 2.2M baseline.

A few numbers called out (baseline 2.2M):
- Gross token cost (model): $1,350 per 1M tokens.
- Estimated batching/caching savings: ~22% (workload dependent).
- Proposed standard net price (after common discounts & expected batching): $1,050 per 1M tokens.
- Reserved plan effective net price (12mo commit): $860 per 1M tokens.

I've also included a short invoice-style estimate page so your procurement team can preview an expected monthly charge under each scenario.

Please review and let me know:
- Which scenario you want us to price for a formal PO (1M / 2.2M / 5M / reserved).
- Any additional compliance notes we should surface for SOC2/VPC peering in the formal proposal.

If it's helpful, we can lock in a quick 30-min call this week to walk procurement through the invoice.

Best,
Sean

Attachments:
- Acme_Cost_Model_20271220.xlsx (spreadsheet, cost breakdown & invoice-style page)
- pricing_calculator_20271220.csv (calculator for quick scenario sensitivity)

------------------------------
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Jules Martin <jules.martin@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-20T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme — Updated invoice estimate & cost model (3 scenarios)

Thanks Sean — reviewed and looks good from an ops & billing perspective. Quick notes for procurement:  

- Invoice reference: PROV-RDW-ACME-2027-045
- If you choose the 2.2M reserved path, we can provide a draft SOW + payment schedule for a 12-month commitment.
- Standard SLA and support terms will be included; if you need an upgraded SLA, we'll add the premium line to the invoice.

Tom — if you confirm the 2.2M reserved scenario, I'll prepare a PO-ready PDF and SOW and loop in legal for standard T&Cs. Prefer to have procurement details (billing contact and PO cadence) in one reply.

Cheers,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
body_summary: Post-call recap and pricing follow-up for Acme Corp. Sean shared draft cost model; Acme confirmed baseline ~2.2M tokens/month and target committed budget $8k-$12k/mo. Sean returned updated invoice estimates with 1M/2.2M/5M scenarios and reserved plan pricing (~$860-$1,050 per 1M tokens). Marissa (ops) provided invoice ref and next steps for PO/SOW. Attachments: updated cost model spreadsheet and pricing calculator.
